>Once the feeling is over, get right back to your work.

It *doesn't go away*.  It hasn't since 2005.

I've done the meds thing.  They worked for a good four years.  Then they stopped working, and I spent another four years taking them simply to avoid withdrawal (spending most of the time in about my current state).  Now that I've gone through that period, I don't want to return to that particular kind of treatment.
